ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 white-to-black pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface, characterized by high-intensity central regions and a low-intensity peripheral boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous zones across both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation is localized to the entire trailing edge margin, a vertical columnar strip at the peduncle insertion extending toward the notch, and isolated focal points (coordinates roughly mid-lobe on both sides).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:3 relative to the notch opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher irregularity compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the leading edges with a smooth upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast white circular pixel groups at the distal tip of the left lobe; additional clusters observed at the base of the peduncle insertion point.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, low-angle linear dark pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left quadrant and multiple sub-parallel marks near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable accumulation of calcified material or scarring (barnacles) at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe; distinct small, dark circular pitting marks scattered across the high-intensity ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: A vertical, dark pigmentation 'pillar' extending from the fluke base toward the median notch, bifurcating slightly at the top.
